deterministic_load.algorithm: Read rights_manifest.json.admitted_source_record_ids in order; materialize exactly those rows only when each row has an admitted rights disposition and an entry in lineage_graph.json.materialized_row_lineage. For this pinset the admitted set is empty, so the loader writes no row payloads and no derived artifacts.

no_go.supersession_rule: A future task may load rows only after a new exact release revision receives a new rights review with authoritative source rights, transformation rights, complete lineage, and explicit row admission.

replay.method: Verify the rights admitted-record list is empty; verify both materialized ID lists are empty; verify the count receipt reports zero admitted and materialized rows; and verify no row payload files are present under this corpus root.
